The scores from the different paths are consistent, suggesting a reliable link between Javanicoside F and SQ20B, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a possible role for Javanicoside F in influencing SQ20B through a series of intermediate targets, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the nature of this relationship.
